request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Paint over the grey patches and dark spots on the rocket with the same bright red, so the rocket body is one big plain bright red shape with a darker red shadow. Keep the grey nose cone and fins, the charcoal cart, the tiny goblin, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
